name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2C Commerce) is an enterprise ecommerce platform whose OCAPI/SCAPI REST APIs use OAuth2 client-credentials auth via Salesforce Account Manager, but a usable sandbox requires being an existing customer or an approved partner rather than self-serve signup.
needs_human_reasons: only 28% of quotes grounded in cited pages
gated/no-API finding with weak grounding needs a human eye

evidence.quote: All client applications that access the Open Commerce API must be registered through the Account Manager.
provide a credentials string in the HTTP header that is composed of your client ID, followed by a colon (:), followed by your client secret (password)
Partners must first join the AppExchange Partner Program under the 'B2C Commerce' Partner Category.
The Trial Sandbox/Environment is created for B2C Commerce ISV prospects
Request your Trial from this link
docs_page signal check: no official or community MCP server listed in registry lookups for Salesforce Commerce Cloud
On-Demand Sandboxes operate on a usage-based pricing model. Partners receive annual free credits based on their partnership tier

notes: SFCC exposes two REST API families: legacy OCAPI (deprecated) and current SCAPI (Shopper, Data/Admin APIs), both authenticated via OAuth2 client-credentials grant against Salesforce Account Manager (client ID + secret -> bearer token). There is no self-serve signup: a working sandbox requires either being an existing customer (Order Form) or an approved AppExchange "B2C Commerce" partner, or submitting a vetted trial-sandbox request form as an ISV prospect (up to 90 days). developer.salesforce.com blocked direct WebFetch (403/bot protection) for several pages, so some auth-page quotes are corroborated via search-engine extraction rather than a direct fetch; access/blocker evidence was independently verified via a successful direct fetch of the help.salesforce.com sandbox-access article. api_breadth is inferred as "large" from the combined OCAPI Data API + SCAPI Shopper/Admin API surface (many resource groups), not from a directly cited endpoint count — treat with moderate confidence. No MCP server (official or community) was found in registry/GitHub lookups.
